items.title: CoreWeave’s stock pops as new financing playbook eases debt concerns
items.description: A third-quarter revenue beat and $9 billion in planned prepayments gave investors renewed confidence in CoreWeave’s business.

items.title: Why Goldman Sachs is now changing its Federal Reserve interest-rate forecast
items.description: Following Tuesday’s hot CPI data , Goldman Sachs is now pencilling in additional Fed tightening.

items.title: I’m 63 and want to spend $95,000 on a roof deck for my $500,000 home. Is that a good investment?
items.description: “I have a net worth of $2.3 million and my only debt is a 15-year mortgage with an outstanding balance of $295,000.”

items.title: ‘The thought of living to 100 terrifies me’: Is Social Security a giant Ponzi scheme?
items.description: There is already a demographic ‘run’ on Social Security.

items.title: Tiger Woods has another private, 18-hole golf destination in the works — this one for Long Island’s Gold Coast
items.description: Golf legend Tiger Woods is heading up a new private golf destination on the North Shore of Long Island in Brookville, N.Y.

items.title: Among full-size SUVs, the 2027 Ford Expedition is worth a look for its spacious seating and mighty engine
items.description: The Ford Expedition has modern tech, a big third row, clever features, and a muscular engine, adding up to make it our favorite full-size SUV.

items.title: One reason Children’s Place is filing for bankruptcy? Not enough children.
items.description: The chain has been contending with falling birth rates, cautious consumers, stiff competition and $881 million in debt.

items.title: ‘We had the worst fight’: I want my husband to retire at 65, but I don’t want to lose his $280,000 salary. Is that unreasonable?
items.description: “We have $2.6 million, most of it in his 401(k) and IRAs, plus $450,000 in a brokerage account.”

items.title: Should a widow leave her late partner’s home to her stepkids — or cut off contact with them?
items.description: “It would be a less drastic step than selling the home now and splitting the proceeds.”

items.title: ‘I’m sick of flying’: I paid for priority boarding, but the overhead bins were full. Was I duped?
items.description: “Maybe next time I’ll try the other approach: I’ll board whenever I feel like it and drop my suitcase in the first open slot I see.”
